items.title: An AstraZeneca, Bristol Myers Squibb merger could create a cancer-drug giant, but analysts call it ‘odd’
items.content: AstraZeneca shares were slumping while Bristol-Myers Squibb’s stock was jumping on Monday on reported deal talks. But the big question is why these two pharmaceutical giants would want to come together in the first place.

items.title: American manufacturers grow at fastest clip in 4 years due to AI boom — but all is not well
items.content: American manufacturers grew in July at the fastest pace in more than four year as they bore the fruits of a massive boom in artificial intelligence, but they’re also being hampered by pandemic-era-like supply shortages and higher inflation.

items.title: Should wealthier Americans forgo their Social Security benefits as a charitable gesture?

items.title: The gap between big tech and the rest of the market just vanished. Here’s what it means for investors.
items.content: Goldman Sachs says hot technology stocks have taken a beating — and investors should take a fresh look.

items.title: Global oil prices fall below $83 a barrel to hover at 3-week low after Trump calls off planned attack and says Iran talks to resume Monday
items.content: Oil prices declined sharply on Monday as hopes rose among investors of a potential de-escalation in the war between the U.S. and Iran.

items.title: ‘My head hit the driver’s window’: A teenager T-boned our car. Will Medicare pay my hospital bills?
items.content: “My car was nearly 20 years old, and I only carried liability and uninsured motorist coverage, not collision coverage.”

items.title: JPMorgan says Warsh failure to buttress Fed credibility may force a rate hike before year-end
items.content: JPMorgan’s U.S. economics team says last week’s post-decision press conference by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh was the most troubling since the practice began in 2012 as the U.S. banking giant moved forward their call for a rate increase.

items.title: If Social Security’s funding crisis is the elephant in the room, this is the mouse everyone has overlooked. You have been warned.
